body: The MiniMax demo paths added here (e.g. `/path/to/MiniMax-H3/FL2VA`) won’t actually match the `MiniMax-H3(/FL2VA|/Ref2VA)?` spec with the current `lookup_model_spec()` logic because it only searches the final path component ("FL2VA"/"Ref2VA"). That means local FL2VA/Ref2VA model paths won’t use `params_builder` at runtime either. Consider updating `lookup_model_spec()` to match the last two path components when the suffix is `FL2VA`/`Ref2VA`.

body: This `params_builder` demonstration call uses an unsupported keyword argument (`task=`). `_minimaxh3_params_builder()` currently expects `extra_params=...`, so running this module directly will raise `TypeError`.
